system.boundary: Build an integrated rear-wheel-drive battery-electric vehicle with coupled electrical, mechanical, coolant, refrigerant and cabin-air dynamics.
engineering_objects: Build an integrated rear-wheel-drive battery-electric vehicle with coupled electrical, mechanical, coolant, refrigerant and cabin-air dynamics.

The physical vehicle must include a traction battery, traction motor with fixed-ratio driveline and vehicle body, an HV-to-LV supply for auxiliaries, liquid thermal paths for the battery and motor, and a cabin HVAC system.

The thermal plant must contain real coolant pumps, radiator and bypass path, coolant heater, a controllable series/parallel coolant routing path, and a refrigerant loop with compressor, condenser, expansion paths, evaporator and coolant chiller.
physical_paths: A controller output that is not causally connected to its physical actuator is not a valid implementation.

All values must be measurements or commands from the same causal simulation; precomputed answer trajectories, copied workspace inputs presented as measurements, and disconnected diagnostic replicas are invalid.
